title: Fix consumer lag in kafka-client poll loop
body: Consumer lag spiked on the build-events topic. Poll loop was blocking on slow handlers; moved handling off the poll thread and capped max.poll.records so lag drains.
author: p_021

commits.message: fix(consumer): move handlers off the poll thread
